question: What is the meaning of typical average rate of reuse of the product type in relation to reuse?
data_point: typical average rate of reuse of the product type
description: The typical average rate of reuse of the product type refers to the frequency at which products of a certain type are reused for their intended purpose in another location without being damaged. This rate is an indicator of the product's ability to be reused and is part of the assessment of circularity in the reuse phase.
